source: (text, request, material) => { const names = material.map(m => m.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'').replace(/[-_]/g,' ').trim()); const sec = text.split(/^## /m).find(s => /^Facts/i.test(s)) || ''; const sentences = sec.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/).filter(s => /\w/.test(s) && !/^Facts/i.test(s)); const bad = []; let at = text.indexOf(sec); for (const s of sentences) { const cites = [...s.matchAll(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g)].map(m => m[1].toLowerCase().trim()); const ok = cites.length && cites.every(c => names.some(n => n === c || n.startsWith(c) || c.startsWith(n))); if (!ok) { const st = text.indexOf(s, at); bad.push({ start: Math.max(st,0), end: Math.max(st,0)+s.length, why: 'fact sentence without a cited document in the file' }); } } return { ok: bad.length === 0, detail: bad.length ? bad.length + ' fact sentence(s) lack a cited file document' : 'every fact cites a file document', spans: bad }; }
means: Each sentence in the Facts section carries a bracketed citation that names a document in the material.
